title: Jucys–Murphy elements as the Hecke shadow of commuting Casimirs
html:
Remark. Jucys–Murphy elements as the Hecke shadow of commuting Casimirs

Remark. The Jucys-Murphy elements are the Hecke-algebraic shadow of commuting Casimirs in U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_n). They are the natural commuting operators that read off the highest weight of an irreducible representation. The cell content c(\square) is the magnetic quantum number m_j of the corresponding \mathrm{SU}_q(2) weight space, making c_\ell(\lambda) a q-deformation of the \ell-th Casimir eigenvalue on V_\lambda. The crystal limit q \to 0 recovers the classical content combinatorics of the Kashiwara crystal.
